skill.summary: A practical guide for maintaining composure and effectiveness when project boundaries expand unexpectedly. Apply Stoic philosophy to one of the most common sources of workplace frustration.

latestVersion.changelog:
Stoic Scope Creep 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a comprehensive guide for using Stoic philosophy to handle scope creep in projects.
- Covers core Stoic practices: Dichotomy of Control, Amor Fati, Negative Visualization.
- Provides practical response frameworks, reflective exercises, and ready-to-use scripts for common scenarios.
- Emphasizes the value of acceptance, clear communication, documentation, and mindset in responding to changing project demands.
- Includes daily practices and meditations for building resilience and composure at work.
